sloka: सुवेषाः शुद्ध वसनाः ताम्र मृष्ट अनुलेपनाः ।सर्वे ते विविधैः यानैः शनैः भरतम् अन्वयुः ॥२-८३-१७॥
transliteration: suveṣāḥ śuddha vasanāḥ tāmra mṛṣṭa anulepanāḥ ।sarve te vividhaiḥ yānaiḥ śanaiḥ bharatam anvayuḥ ॥2-83-17॥

translations.english: Dressed well in clean clothes and anointed with pure red sandalpaste, they all slowly followed Bharata, mounting on various vehicles.
